transcription: Main article text only (share widget, the right-sidebar lesson navigation repeated three times around the article, and the 'Download Image' utility link removed). The caption of the cycle diagram figure ('The basic hydrologic (water) cycle') kept as its own line; the two uncaptioned illustrative images inside the Condensation and Runoff sections contribute no text. purpose: library: the water cycle as an ordered set of processes — the five named stages (evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, runoff), each with its mechanism (energy sources for evaporation; the 1% growth / 99% atmosphere split of transpired water; dew point and saturation for condensation and its released heat feeding hurricanes; the ~38½ inch (980 mm) average annual world precipitation; runoff feeding rivers, lakes and terminal salt lakes such as the Great Salt Lake and the Dead Sea). Fits step ordering (the cycle), quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the percentages and precipitation figure, and a concept map of the cycle processes.
